This list was reconstructed from the GEMP replay of Brad Kippel's semifinals game against [[Timo Dusel]] and is incomplete. It shows only cards that Brad Kippel revealed, played or drew in that game, and each count is the most copies seen at one time.<ref name="replay">[https://gemp.starwarsccg.org/gemp-swccg/game.html?replayId=dillen$sgskm4upgt0rmy7m GEMP replay: Semifinals, Timo Dusel vs. Brad Kippel], gemp.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy (replay data): none yet</ref><ref name="video">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hbi3fs0mvrI&t=6603s SWCCG CNVM: 2025 Invitational Deck Techs and Game Analysis from the Event Winner], BillBisco2, YouTube (1 February 2026), from 1:50:03. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012142507/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hbi3fs0mvrI Internet Archive]</ref>
